claims.claim: An article dated Sept 23 reports an OCBC ATM, internet and mobile banking disruption
claims.reason: S1, published 2026-09-23, reports a disruption to OCBC's ATM, Internet and mobile-phone banking services that day.
S1 says all customer data was protected with 'appropriate security measures'.
S1 presents the David Conner quote as a current statement. Neither source says or implies that the quote or the CEO attribution is out of date. This judgment comes from outside the cited text.
S2 reports OCBC shares fell 1.5% on Sep 23 but does not mention any disruption. No cited source contradicts the claim that nothing corroborates it.
